# Local Multimodal LLM for Unreal Engine

> A Win64 Unreal Engine 5.8 runtime plug-in for private offline NPC dialogue,
> native GGUF inference, speech recognition, speech synthesis, multi-character
> memory, dialogue routing, relationship context, and constrained Unreal tools.

Maintainer: Ian Sundahl / Volley Studios
Repository: https://github.com/isundahl/LLM_Plugin
Releases: https://github.com/isundahl/LLM_Plugin/releases
License: Apache-2.0 for original plug-in code and documentation; bundled
third-party runtimes, models, and voices retain their own terms.
Requested credit: Local Multimodal LLM created by Ian Sundahl and Volley Studios.

## Integration summary

Install Starter Core or Starter NVIDIA at the project root, enable Local
Multimodal LLM and Audio Capture, compile once, add the Local LLM, microphone,
and text-to-speech components, load the default model, create one session per
character, and route sentence deltas to Queue Speech. Use allow-listed tool
calls for gameplay mutations. See the complete guide before shipping.
